snippet.title: CanvasCraft - PC Gameplay (Microsoft Store)
snippet.description:
Fun and addictive puzzle game! Mix and Match Colors! Infinite Gameplay!

ARCADE MODE:
Race against the time to match your canvas with an automatically generated one. Complete the canvas as fast as you can to earn more points!

PRACTICE MODE:
Play casually and take all the time you need when mixing and matching your colors on your canvas.

Canvascraft (C) Throwback Entertainment Inc.
Microsoft Store link: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/canvascraft/9nblggh51hjk?activetab=pivot:overviewtab

#theforeseenarcade #windows #windows10 #microsoftstore #canvascraft #throwbackentertainment

FUN FACT: This is published AND developed by Throwback Entertainment, a Canadian-based company that currently owns the IP rights to Kenji Eno's "D", Powerslave (AKA Exhumed), Tunnel B1 (after buying it from Piko Interactive), and select games from the back catalogue of Acclaim Entertainment and MIRROR Soft.
